verdict: No significant, material deterioration versus the baseline. The location and cause sections describe the background pattern of the (few) problem arrivals, not a new issue.

evidence: [F] 95% of late trains were already late at 7 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 18 Av: 141, at Church Av: 13, at Fort Hamilton Pkwy: 11, on approach from 7 Av: 10. Largest time loss on segment Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy (median +55s vs schedule).
[F] 81% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 7 Av.

[G] 93% of late trains were already late at 7 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Church Av: 98, at Fort Hamilton Pkwy: 25, on approach from 7 Av: 10, at 15 St-Prospect Park: 9. Largest time loss on segment Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy (median +84s vs schedule).
[G] 85% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 7 Av.
Weekend problem rate is 1.7x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
65% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 1.4x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 34% of delays on line(s) F, G (1.5x the system share) in the analysed months.
[G] 66% of late trains were already late leaving Church Av: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.
[G] 77% of the run-time loss sits on one segment (Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy, median +84s): a signal timer, speed restriction, or failure on that segment.

[F] Time is lost a little at every stop (Ditmas Av -> Church Av +25s, Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy +55s, 15 St-Prospect Park -> 7 Av +25s): a dwell-time / crowding pattern rather than one bad segment.
30% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 95%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
11% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'signal' alert was active for the line (problem rate 35% with an alert vs 17% without, lift 2.0x).
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 272s on average vs 88s otherwise (3.1x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.

recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Coney Island-Stillwell Av during the affected hours: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Inspect Church Av -> Fort Hamilton Pkwy for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Dwell-time programme at 4 Av-9 St and the stops before it during the affected hours: platform controllers, door-closing announcements, step-back crews
recommendations.rationale: Run-time loss is spread across every stop on the approach, the signature of long dwells.
recommendations.expected_effect: Each stop recovers its excess dwell; the effect compounds along the line.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for F, G; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for F, G; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Check whether scheduled dwell and run times on the approach still match observed loads; re-time the schedule if not
recommendations.rationale: A schedule with unrealistic dwells makes every train late by design.
